scope: Local HTML weather prototype only; not real forecast, production mini-program or WeChat device validation
interactionChecks: 6000m outside layer coverage displays 无层资料, not 0%
Along-route gust values and selected point update while retaining 11/1 13:00
Unknown elevation retains hourly data and model cloud field but hides node line, states missing altitude
Location search no-result and recovery work
Slider keyboard changes selected hour and values; 48h produces48 columns; reload preserves point/date/hour/view
Activity detail opens matching 四姑娘山 +11/8 weather, back restores detail route position
375/390/414px simulated device frames: all4 modes have no body overflow; time-chart internal scrolling intentionally retained
Hourly and cloud SVG now render at their full 42px-per-hour width; selected cursor centered without delayed scroll race
Read-chart help opens and closes; closed overlay does not block next actions

dataContractReview.result: finite values; valid numeric ranges; gust >= wind; outside coverage remains null

regressionsFixed: CSS global svg width made the chart blank; weather-chart width now follows its time-axis canvas
72h ->24h on next-day hour now rebases to selected day and retains its hour
Missing-altitude caption now distinguishes absent green node line from amber read-height line
Programmatic cursor centering uses immediate scrolling so reading the previous animated offset cannot reset the view

screenshots.note: Primary screenshots capture the visible part of a390px device frame; hourly-full and unknown are full browser-page screenshots. Blank full-page+clip attempt was rejected and overwritten.

limitations: All weather values, elevations, map geometry and astronomical times are synthetic fixtures
Along-route independent weather comparison is a design proposal and needs separate point fetches in production
No real weather loading, cache, error recovery or astronomical/phenomenon calculations
Coordinate query, GPX import and saved independent observation points remain outside this prototype implementation
Frame width tests use desktop viewport with simulated phone container; they are not physical device tests
